title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial (November 19, 2026)
summary: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will continue on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 44: What to expect

The second week of the presentation of evidence of the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to feature four witnesses who will testify on the status of Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared asset of the Vice President’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio.
